description:
Register a new Operator in the DPYC community registry.

Called by an Authority service when its owner approves an operator's
adoption request; the request must be signed with the Authority's key.

authority_npub.description:
npub of the sponsoring Authority (must already
exist as an authority or prime_authority in the registry).

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the Operator service.

operator_npub.description: Nostr npub of the new Operator.

service_url.description: Public MCP endpoint URL of the Operator service.

name: register_operator
title: Register Operator
